passive.name: Iceborn Subjugation
passive.description: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra they become a Frozen Thrall. Frozen Thralls slow nearby enemies and then, after a delay, shatter from the intense cold, dealing magic damage to nearby targets.

spells.name: Ice Shard
spells.description: Lissandra throws a spear of ice that shatters on the first enemy hit, dealing magic damage, Slowing them by % for seconds, and also damaging and slowing the enemies behind them.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Ring of Frost
spells.description: Lissandra creates an ice field, Rooting nearby enemies for seconds and dealing magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Glacial Path
spells.description: Lissandra casts forth an ice claw that deals magic damage. Lissandra can Recast while the claw travels to teleport to its location.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Frozen Tomb
spells.description: Lissandra encases herself or an enemy champion in ice. Enemies are Stunned for seconds. When self cast, Lissandra enters Stasis for seconds and restores Health, increased by % for each % missing Health. In either case, dark ice eminates from the target, dealing magic damage. The ice persists for seconds, Slowing enemies by %.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation CalculatedDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
